free.question: Is the AI clothes changer free?
free.answer: Yes. New users get 10 free credits so they can test real virtual try-on quality before buying more credits or a paid plan.

reference.question: Can I upload a clothing photo as a reference?
reference.answer: Yes. The intended workflow supports either uploading a clothing reference or using preset styles, so users can try a specific garment or explore a style idea.

photos.question: What photos work best?
photos.answer: Clear person photos work best, especially front-facing portraits or full-body images with visible clothing edges. Avoid heavy blur, extreme poses, or blocked outfits.

face.question: Will it keep my face and body shape?
face.answer: The product goal is to preserve identity, pose, lighting, and body proportions while changing the outfit area. Results can still vary by photo quality.

privacy.question: Do you save uploaded photos?
privacy.answer: Your photos are encrypted during processing and automatically deleted from our servers after the try-on is complete.

redefining.title: Redefining the Virtual Fitting Room
redefining.body: At aiclotheschanger.me, we believe that fashion technology should be accessible, transparent, and, above all, realistic. We observed a market filled with applications that demand payment before showing a single result. We decided to build a better way.

mission.label: Our Mission
mission.title: Quality First, Trust Always
mission.body1: We specialize in high-fidelity AI Clothes Changer technology. Our platform is not just about swapping pixels; it is about understanding how a silk dress drapes or how a denim jacket fits different body types.
mission.body2: We are committed to solving the trust gap in the industry by offering a Try First, Pay Later model, giving every user 10 free credits to witness our quality before committing to a plan.

technology.label: The Technology Behind the Result
technology.title: Keeping the complexity for us, and the simplicity for you

privacy.label: Your Privacy is Non-Negotiable
privacy.title: Encrypted during processing, deleted after try-on
privacy.body: We strictly follow global data protection standards. Every image you upload is encrypted during processing and automatically deleted from our servers the moment your try-on is complete.

join.label: Join the Fashion Revolution
join.title: Your personal, digital wardrobe
join.body: Whether you are a shopper trying to avoid wrong-size returns or a fashion enthusiast exploring new styles, aiclotheschanger.me is your personal, digital wardrobe.

realism.title: True-to-Life Realism
realism.text: We focus on realistic fabric texture, drape, and lighting so the result feels closer to a true outfit preview than a generic image edit.

inclusive.title: Inclusivity by Design
inclusive.text: We give extra attention to plus-size and men's styling paths so users are not forced into one narrow idea of who virtual try-on is for.

stability.title: Technical Stability
stability.text: We keep working on the frustrating basics too, including mobile upload handling, clearer progress, and a simpler generation experience.

virtual-try-on-clothes.body2: Use it for online shopping decisions, creator styling, product previews, and quick outfit comparisons without changing clothes or booking a shoot.

plus-size-virtual-try-on.title: Inclusive Plus Size Virtual Try On & AI Clothes Changer
plus-size-virtual-try-on.description: Preview outfits on curvy and plus size body types before shopping, styling, or creating content.
plus-size-virtual-try-on.body1: Many virtual fitting tools make users infer fit from a narrow model set. This plus size virtual try-on path focuses on curvy body representation, realistic outfit previews, and practical photo guidance.
plus-size-virtual-try-on.body2: For better results, upload a front-facing full-body photo in natural light. This gives the AI more reliable body mapping for fabric drape, sleeve length, waist placement, and silhouette.

mens-ai-clothes-changer.description: Upload a male photo and try new outfits online, from casual looks to sharper shirts, jackets, and workwear.
mens-ai-clothes-changer.body1: Men's outfit try-on intent is often different: shirts, suits, jackets, streetwear, profile photos, and clean workwear matter more than generic fashion effects.
mens-ai-clothes-changer.body2: This page gives men's searches a focused path while still sending users into the same simple AI clothes changer flow.

about-us.title: Redefining the Virtual Fitting Room
about-us.description: aiclotheschanger.me makes fashion technology more accessible, transparent, and realistic with true virtual try-on without the paywall.
about-us.body1: At aiclotheschanger.me, we believe fashion technology should be accessible, transparent, and above all realistic. We saw a market full of apps that demand payment before showing a single result, so we decided to build a better way.
about-us.body2: Our mission is quality first, trust always. We specialize in high-fidelity AI clothes changer technology that understands how a silk dress drapes, how a denim jacket fits different body types, and why users need to see quality before committing to a plan.
about-us.body3: We keep the complexity for us and the simplicity for you. The product experience focuses on realistic outfit previews, clearer credit flow, plus-size and men's styling paths, and privacy-first processing.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.description: Privacy-first principles for uploaded photos, generated results, login, credits, and billing.
privacy-policy.body1: Uploaded photos are encrypted during processing and automatically deleted from our servers when the try-on is complete.
privacy-policy.body2: We also maintain content and usage rules to reduce explicit, unsafe, or abusive requests across uploads, prompts, and account activity.
privacy-policy.bullet4: Privacy and billing handled from one account flow

terms-of-service.title: Terms of Service
terms-of-service.description: Rules for lawful uploads, responsible AI use, payments, refunds, cancellation, and credits.
terms-of-service.body1: Users may only upload images they own or have legal permission to use. The service may not be used for commercial fraud, impersonation, explicit content, or copyright infringement.
terms-of-service.body2: Payments, renewals, cancellations, and credit use are expected to stay clear to the user, and failed system generations can be reviewed for credit adjustment.
terms-of-service.bullet1: User owns or controls uploaded content
terms-of-service.bullet4: Failed system generations can be refunded
